_comment: Pre-registered hook-latency budget (road-to-credible-install Phase 1). Committed BEFORE the first optimization landed, per the roadmap's pre-registration discipline: the numbers below are the acceptance bar the precompile + single-process work is measured against, not a post-hoc fit. Consumed by the bench harness (scripts/bench_hook_latency) and its CI gate. Every budget carries an owner and a review date per the Phase-6 budget-ownership lint.

hardware_reference.ci: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest runner (the numbers the gate enforces)
hardware_reference.floor: 1 vCPU reference container (documented ceiling, not CI-enforced)

regression_gate._comment: A PR that worsens a recorded p95 by more than this fails the bench gate even while still under the absolute budget.

honest_null_consequence: If the budget is missed after precompile + single-process + lazy I/O, hooks ship default-off with an explicit opt-in flag and the measured numbers published under a 'known cost' heading. A resident-dispatcher daemon is NOT improvised as a rescue (council 2026-07-26).
